system.name: Hacking
system.description: Fires a probe that latches onto one enemy system. Once it holds, you can see into that room, and each pulse shuts the system down for a few seconds.

system.name: Intrusion Array
system.description: The Senti's hacking. It reaches into one enemy system through its own signals. Once it holds, you can see into that room, and each pulse shuts the system down for a few seconds.

system.name: Mind Control
system.description: Takes over one enemy crew member for a while. Until it wears off, they fight for your side.

system.name: Pheromone Gland
system.description: The Azurethea's mind control. A cloud of pheromone spores turns one enemy crew member against their own side for a while.

system.name: Armoured Avatar Array
system.description: Stores and broadcasts the ship's Senti crew. A Senti killed in a fight is broadcast again from the array. If the array is damaged, fewer Senti can be broadcast until it is repaired.

system.name: Shield Projector
system.description: The Senti's shields. Every bar of power holds one shield layer, and each layer stops one laser or flak hit. Layers come back half as fast as a Shield Generator's. Missiles and bombs pass through.

system.name: Backup Battery
system.description: When switched on, gives the ship extra power for a short time, then needs time to recharge.

system.name: System Battery
system.description: A battery bound to one system, most often the Armoured Avatar Array. It keeps that system powered when the core or its conduit is cut.
